verdict.rationale: Ledgy's own marketing says it offers 70+ HRIS integrations that keep data accurate, and that custom fields can be synced in one click, so a first-party HRIS sync exists. The evidence never says which systems are covered, or that hires and terminations update stakeholder and equity records automatically. Missing for 10: named support for Gusto/Rippling or a payroll system, documented automatic flow of new hires and terminations into stakeholder records, sync frequency and field-mapping docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, stakeholders sync from my HRIS/payroll system (e.g. Gusto, Rippling) so new hires and terminations flow into equity records automatically

citations.quote: Leverage the power of 70+ HRIS integrations to keep large volumes of data accurate.
With Ledgy’s custom fields, you can sync exactly what you need in one click.
